items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I had never even heard of Bechet before... I didn't know who he was, but he sure was playing. Then I found out afterwards that he was Sidney Bechet.

ctx.x: So chances are he'd already been to the Roseland.

I don't know if he went to the Roseland. He was working uptown in Harlem then. I don't know whether he went downtown or anything like that. But he was interested in blowin' his horn.
